facts.text: Drexel Co-op integrates full-time professional work experiences directly into students' undergraduate academic plans of study.
First-year students are required to live on campus or with a parent or legal guardian living within ten miles of campus for their first two years.
Drexel students must complete the number of co-op units their program requires in order to graduate.
